title: Allow adding widgets to the lock screen
line: You can now pick widgets in the lock screen settings and they show on the lock screen, for example CPU, memory and network monitors.
explanation: The lock screen could only show its own clock and media controls, so people who keep system monitors or other widgets on their desktop had nothing of that while locked; showing the desktop itself is not an option for privacy. The Screen Locking settings' Appearance page now has a Widgets list with an Add Widget… search dialog (same widget list as the desktop's widget explorer). The greeter loads those widgets in a small Plasma corona of its own, and the lock screen shows them in a column on the primary screen, with their normal background, read-only.

commits.message:
greeter: allow showing a set of widgets on the lock screen

The lock screen only had its own clock, so people who keep system
monitors or other widgets on their desktop lost them when locking. The
greeter now loads the widgets picked on the Appearance settings page.

BUG: 449065

lockscreen: show the widgets chosen in the lock screen settings

The greeter can now load a separate set of widgets, but the lock screen
had no place for them. They now go in a column at the side of the
screen with their usual background, and can't be clicked or focused.

BUG: 449065

patches.diff:
From e6689f624352f2d5043403eb201ea778bfa85f32 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:34:47 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] lockscreen: show the widgets chosen in the lock screen
 settings

The greeter can now load a separate set of widgets, but the lock screen
had no place for them. They now go in a column at the side of the
screen with their usual background, and can't be clicked or focused.

BUG: 449065
---
 .../contents/lockscreen/LockScreen.qml        |  1 +
 .../contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml      | 63 +++++++++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 64 insertions(+)

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreen.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreen.qml
index f6bae57838..013dfca7ee 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreen.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreen.qml
@@ -15,6 +15,7 @@ Item {
 
     // These are magical properties that kscreenlocker looks for
     property bool viewVisible: false
+    property list<Item> widgets
 
     LayoutMirroring.enabled: Application.layoutDirection === Qt.RightToLeft
     LayoutMirroring.childrenInherit: true
diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
index 065a33c131..0d76ef3ecf 100644
--- a/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/lockscreen/LockScreenUi.qml
@@ -19,6 +19,7 @@ import org.kde.plasma.workspace.components as PW
 import org.kde.plasma.workspace.keyboardlayout as Keyboards
 import org.kde.plasma.private.keyboardindicator as KeyboardIndicator
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
+import org.kde.ksvg as KSvg
 import org.kde.kscreenlocker as ScreenLocker
 import org.kde.ki18n
 
@@ -273,6 +274,68 @@ Item {
             Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignBaseline
         }
 
+        // Widgets chosen in the lock screen settings; they only show information
+        FocusScope {
+            anchors {
+                left: parent.left
+                leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2
+                verticalCenter: parent.verticalCenter
+            }
+            width: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 14
+            height: Math.min(widgetsLayout.implicitHeight, parent.height - Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 6)
+
+            onActiveFocusChanged: {
+                if (activeFocus) {
+                    mainStack.forceActiveFocus();
+                }
+            }
+
+            ColumnLayout {
+                id: widgetsLayout
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                spacing: Kirigami.Units.gridUnit
+
+                Repeater {
+                    model: root.widgets
+
+                    delegate: KSvg.FrameSvgItem {
+                        id: widgetFrame
+
+                        required property Item modelData
+                        readonly property int backgroundHints: modelData.plasmoid?.effectiveBackgroundHints ?? 1
+
+                        Layout.fillWidth: true
+                        Layout.fillHeight: true
+                        Layout.minimumHeight: Math.max(modelData.Layout.minimumHeight, Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 6) + margins.top + margins.bottom
+                        Layout.preferredHeight: Math.max(modelData.Layout.preferredHeight > 0 ? modelData.Layout.preferredHeight : Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 8, Layout.minimumHeight)
+                        Layout.maximumHeight: Layout.preferredHeight
+                        // Hide widgets that don't fit on the screen rather than cutting them off
+                        opacity: y + height <= widgetsLayout.height ? 1 : 0
+
+                        imagePath: (backgroundHints & 2) ? "widgets/translucentbackground" : ((backgroundHints & 1) ? "widgets/background" : "")
+                        Kirigami.Theme.inherit: imagePath === ""
+                        Kirigami.Theme.colorSet: Kirigami.Theme.Window
+
+                        Component.onCompleted: {
+                            modelData.parent = widgetFrame;
+                            modelData.anchors.fill = widgetFrame;
+                            modelData.anchors.leftMargin = Qt.binding(() => widgetFrame.margins.left);
+                            modelData.anchors.topMargin = Qt.binding(() => widgetFrame.margins.top);
+                            modelData.anchors.rightMargin = Qt.binding(() => widgetFrame.margins.right);
+                            modelData.anchors.bottomMargin = Qt.binding(() => widgetFrame.margins.bottom);
+                        }
+                    }
+                }
+            }
+
+            MouseArea {
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                acceptedButtons: Qt.AllButtons
+                onPressed: lockScreenRoot.uiVisible = true
+                onWheel: wheel => wheel.accepted = true
+            }
+        }
+
         ListModel {
             id: users

media.caption: Lock screen on master: only the clock, even with widgets set in kscreenlockerrc
Lock screen with CPU, memory and network widgets picked in the settings
Screen Locking > Appearance on master: no way to add widgets
New Widgets section above the wallpaper settings, with Remove buttons
Add Widget… opens a search dialog over all installed widgets
Two screens: the widgets go only on the primary output (here the right one)
